name: JW Marriott Mount Kenya Rhino Reserve Safari Camp
positioning: All-inclusive tented safari camp in the Solio Conservancy, between Mount Kenya and the Aberdare Ranges, known for rhino sightings
best_for: Travelers who want to see white and black rhinos on safari
Families wanting a two-bedroom tented suite

facts.text: The camp sits within the Solio Conservancy, between the slopes of Mount Kenya and the peaks of the Aberdare Ranges.
The address is Solio Ranch, Solio Game Reserve, Laikipia, Kenya.
The sanctuary's rhino breeding programme offers sightings of both white and endangered black rhinos, alongside leopards, cheetahs, plains game and bird life.
The tented suites use rich natural textures, from walls to floor to bedding, and have panoramic views.
A two-bedroom suite gives families space to relax together.
Wellness spaces include the signature Spa by JW.
The nightly rate typically includes the room, meals, snacks, and non-alcoholic and alcoholic drinks.
The camp is family-friendly and open to guests of all ages.
Mavuno, the all-day restaurant, cooks with locally sourced ingredients and heritage recipes.
At Ember Bar and Lounge, guests can gather by firelight or under the African sky over cocktails and wines inspired by local botanicals.
The fitness studio blends modern equipment with safari calm.

highlights.text: The sanctuary's rhino breeding programme offers sightings of both white and endangered black rhinos.
Adventures range from night game drives to visits to a private rhino orphanage.
Guests stay in tented suites with private plunge pools.
Before arrival, guests get a personal call with the General or Camp Manager to learn their preferences.
In the JW Garden, herbs, vegetables and edible flowers are harvested daily for seasonal menus and infusions.

considerations.text: Jomo Kenyatta International Airport is about 190 km from the camp.
Spa treatments, laundry, tours and premium items may cost extra on top of the inclusive rate.
